data_policy: Example businesses, logos, addresses, bank data and signatures are not application fixtures; render only authorized saved company/quotation data. Missing invoice-only fields must not be invented.
verification_status: IMPLEMENTATION IN PROGRESS; not a visual-parity certification
quotation_data_adaptations: Quotation/estimate title instead of falsely labelling it a posted tax invoice.
Only saved customer-safe item codes are available; a product SKU must not be labelled HSN/SAC.
Do not infer CGST/SGST/IGST splits from current master data when the quotation snapshot has only aggregate GST.
Do not invent received payments, debt, bank details, QR payment instructions or transport fields absent from the safe quotation DTO.
Latest supplied fifteen-image set and user-authorized naming govern the catalogue; original audit wording remains preserved in the finding register.
